scripts.check: npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && biome check . && npm run lint:ts-comments && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run lint:backend && npm run format:backend:check
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini revision --autogenerate
scripts.fix: biome check --write . && uv run --project backend ruff check --fix backend && uv run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.format:backend:check: uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project backend ruff check backend
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:deploy && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:e2e: npm exec --prefix frontend -- playwright test --config frontend/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:backend: uv run --project backend mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/app
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
